target_users: 需要复核批量实验报告的教研团队
core_problem: 高校实验报告常以图文 Word 流转；通用 AI 把建议留在聊天框，教师仍要手工定位、批注、填分和写评语。
closed_loop: 导入实验要求并确认 rubric
解析报告正文、表格、图片、代码和原 Word 位置
按维度评分并建立证据引用
将低置信度或证据不足案例送入教师复核
回写 Word 原生批注、最终成绩和教师评语
聚合班级薄弱维度并生成讲评建议

source_project.name: GameAssistant
reused_scope: FastAPI 与 Vue 3 应用骨架
rubric 驱动的 Agent 评分
Word 批注与 Excel 导出
批量任务和人工复核基础流程

new_contributions: 高校实验报告的通用参赛产品闭环
教师终审与不可替代教育评价的边界设计
模拟数据、评测指标与合规验证
可复用的通用 rubric 与教师自定义 rubric JSON
MiniMax-M3 真实模型输出到 GradeTrace 的强契约适配
模型调用前自动脱敏、图片单任务授权和显式降级
图片证据到原 Word 段落定位与原生批注锚点
任意图文 Word 保真复制、标准批改页、最终成绩和教师评语回写
真实模型在线 Demo、无密钥离线基线、独立 API 与两分钟演示视频

model_strategy.structured_contract: Every response must map to GradeTrace and pass criterion, range, evidence-reference, and total-score validation
model_strategy.privacy_boundary: Bounded de-identified text by default; up to four images only with per-task teacher opt-in
model_strategy.reproducible_profile: Deterministic local baseline produces the same GradeTrace shape without a model key
model_strategy.fallback: Timeout, quota, transport, or contract failure is visibly marked before deterministic fallback

human_decision_boundary: AI 输出仅作为教师批改建议。成绩、评语、学情结论和对学生的正式反馈均由教师确认后生效。

data_policy.public_submission: Only public, synthetic, or authorized de-identified data
data_policy.real_student_data: Local processing by default; purpose limitation; access control; configurable retention and deletion
data_policy.forbidden: Unlicensed personal data, sensitive personal information, private course data, and undisclosed student work

current_status: Image-rich Word end-to-end demo implemented and verified: original image/paragraph mapping, MiniMax-M3 grading, GradeTrace validation, native Word comments, teacher score and feedback write-back, editable DOCX delivery, diagnosis, and deletion
license_status: Standalone public repository licensed under Apache-2.0; synthetic demo data only; commercial model services are disclosed external dependencies
